question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"justify."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Justify"** means to provide a reason or explanation for something. (किसी बात के औचित्‍य का निरूपण करना, सफ़ाई देना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Can you **justify**__ your decision?*
 
 
 
• In this context, the blank is asking for the most appropriate option to fill in the fifth spot.
 
• By choosing option 2, we are saying that the best choice is to** "justify" **the answer rather than any of the other options.
 
• The correct answer is option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

Humans have __assumed__ that animals do not have a life and maybe exploited in any way they see fit, but this __perspective__ is incorrect and must be altered before it is too late. We fail to recognise that the pain we __inflict__ on animals will come back to haunt us, and no matter how __significant__ the discovery we make by causing harm to animals, it will be futile. It can never __**justify**__ the human actions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "specify,"** means to identify or describe something in detail. (स्‍पष्‍टता या विस्‍तार से कुछ कहना या किसी का उल्‍लेख करना)
 
• **Option 3, "nullify," **means to make something invalid or ineffective. (आधिकारिक रूप से किसी समझौता, आदेश आदि को क़ानूनी रूप से निष्प्रभावी घोषित करना; रद्द करना; निरस्त करना)
 
• **Option 4, "classify," **means to categorize or organize something according to certain criteria. (समान प्रकार की वस्‍तुओं या व्‍यक्तियों को एक वर्ग में रखना; वर्गीकृत करना)
